class Plain{x=1;constructor(){return this;}}
class Empty{constructor(){return 5;}}
class Replacement{x=1;constructor(){return {x:2};}}
class Generic<T>{x:T;constructor(x:T){this.x=x;return {x};}}
class Contextual{fn!:(n:number)=>number;constructor(){return {fn:n=>n+1};}}
class Bare{x=1;constructor(flag:boolean){if(flag)return;}}
class DerivedGood extends Plain{constructor(){super();return this;}}
class EmptyDerived extends Empty{constructor(){super();return 5;}}
class ReturnAny{x=1;constructor(){return 5 as any;}}
function fail():never{throw new Error("fail");}
class NeverReturn{x=1;constructor(){return fail();}}
console.log(new Plain(),new Empty(),new Replacement(),new Generic(3),new Contextual().fn(4),new Bare(true),new DerivedGood(),new ReturnAny());
try{new EmptyDerived();}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError);}
try{new NeverReturn();}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof Error);}
